title: URL import: clean site suffixes from titles, drop marketing-blurb descriptions
summary: URL import polish on main 401406d5 (C r3, supersedes r2 on the parked base): imported titles no longer carry the site suffix; pipe, double-colon, en/em dash and hyphen suffixes strip only when the trimmed suffix equals the registrable site name or holds it as its own token (eat.com no longer strips Wheat and Cheese; r2 substring membership removed), leading www dropped, co.za-style collapse, a non-site suffix keeps the title verbatim and untrimmed; CTA descriptions drop, genuine ones keep their 300-char cap. Ingredient text untouched. Collision fixture pinned both sides. Native UNRUN.
